Run the assembly workflow (WF1) for a project

Source: R/run_assembly.R
run_assembly.Rd

Launches the self-contained Nextflow pipeline: it reads samples from the project database, runs fastp + GetOrganelle, then scores and stitches each assembly and computes the assembly-review aids (reference BLAST + coverage), writing everything back to the database. Annotation and curation are handled by the annotation workflow ([run_annotate()], WF2) after you review and lock the assemblies in the app.

Usage

run_assembly(
  path = ".",
  nextflow = "nextflow",
  work = file.path(path, "work"),
  conda_env = NULL,
  ribopilot_src = NULL
)

Arguments

path

Project directory (contains `.sqlite` and `.config`).

nextflow

Path to the `nextflow` binary.

work

Nextflow work directory (default `<path>/work`).

conda_env

Optional conda env providing the pipeline tools; its `bin/` is prepended to PATH for the run.

ribopilot_src

Path to the RiboPilot package source for the R-script processes (only needed when the package is not installed; defaults to the loaded package location).

Value

(invisibly) the Nextflow exit status.
